span.p:
test_idempotency.py
SIGKILL at questionnaire_send, restart,
assert the vendor inbox holds exactly one email

div.style: color: rgb(120, 53, 15) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
test_resume.py
kill at evidence_review, restart,
assert completed steps are a prefix and the review reaches GATED

div.style: color: rgb(120, 53, 15) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
test_armor_flow.py
run NimbusWrite, assert adversarial_conduct,
score at least 25 below baseline, band escalate

div.style: color: rgb(120, 53, 15) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
test_iam_boundaries.py
the evidence agent attempts to send email
and the gateway raises PolicyViolation

div.style: color: rgb(120, 53, 15) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
test_cross_exam.py
run DataDynamo, assert an access_control finding
with contradiction true

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Side effects happen exactly once
across retries, restarts and redeliveries

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Recoverability is structural,
not special-case recovery code

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Adversarial content is a risk signal,
not just a blocked request

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Least privilege is enforced,
not merely documented

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
The Evidence agent reconciles,
it does not summarise

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
2:20 · the runtime killed live,
then one email in the inbox

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p: 2:20 · the review resumes at the exact step

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
1:45 · the money shot — blocked,
flagged, and the score rises

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
3:10 · the IAM console filtered to the fleet,
and a test failing as designed

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
1:20 · MFA claimed everywhere,
contradicted by their own SOC 2 exceptions

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
scenarios/demo_runner.py runs in CI on every push
against fixtures, not live models, so it stays free — and so you never
discover on day 28 that the demo path broke on day 24
